visualize_densepose_results: visualize DensePose chart results on a BGR image using the DensePoseResultsVisualizer base class
visualize_masked_colormap: visualize IUV data as a colored matrix overlay on an image using DensePoseMaskedColormapResultsVisualizer
visualize_contour_mpl: visualize U and V coordinate contour lines on an image using DensePoseResultsMplContourVisualizer with matplotlib
visualize_contour_custom: visualize U and V coordinate contour lines using marching squares via DensePoseResultsCustomContourVisualizer
visualize_fine_segmentation: visualize fine body part segmentation labels on an image using DensePoseResultsFineSegmentationVisualizer
